data.title: bn-1wp: Engagement manifest and scoped policy
data.description: Frozen v1 engagement and policy declarations, immutable pass-pinned revisions, and pure access decisions. Review exact implementation commit 08f02e6d6e7a4a863f25cb66703064d059107c98. Full just check and eight focused tests passed.

data.body: MEDIUM — Enforce the canonical integer range at declaration validation. Both JSON and TOML EngagementDraft::validate return Ok for max_verify_runs=9007199254740992, but accept fails later with a generic manifest Canonical(UnsafeNumber). A document policy also parses a byte range ending at 9007199254740993 and has no subsequent numeric admission check. These are immutable evidence inputs. Apply the existing canonical safe-integer limit to numeric declaration fields across both paths and report the affected stanza, with tests at the boundary and one past it.

MEDIUM — Preserve the enclosing stanza for duplicate-key diagnostics. Duplicating read inside the fixture orders TOML table produces only engagement: malformed document. Duplicating session inside the JSON principal gives only engagement: duplicate JSON key, and a duplicate identity in policy source.admission gives only policy rule. In each case the document is refused, but the operator cannot locate the stanza as required by bn-1wp. Preserve a schema-owned path or redacted stanza from the parser for nested duplicates, and test both formats without surfacing arbitrary labels or values.

data.reason: Canonical-range validation and nested duplicate diagnostics need fixes at 08f02e6d6e7a4a863f25cb66703064d059107c98. See th-3fj0oz and th-qh3rn5.

data.body: Fixed at 86131ccfda8f491d340574c2f6ebb5491da55965. Engagement parsing enforces the canonical integer range in JSON and TOML, and policy JSON reports the exact citation start or end stanza on overflow. Boundary and one-past tests pass.

Both produce schema-owned redacted stanzas. Regression coverage includes escaped JSON and TOML names and TOML inline, dotted, and repeated-table duplicates.

data.reason: Verified at 86131cc: 28 independent JSON, TOML, document and inferred citation cases accepted representable integers and rejected out-of-range values with field-level errors. The full core test suite and frozen schema checks passed.
